# Support

Start with the [Fluence.Wpf Website](https://fluencewpf.com/). The website contains all of the documentation, guidance for getting started and various tutorials for intermediate and advanced useage.

The [Fluence.Wpf gallery demo](Fluence.Wpf.Demo/README.md) and [MVVM demo](Fluence.Wpf.Demo.Mvvm/README.md) provide runnable examples. Check [known issues](KNOWN_ISSUES.md) and the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) before filing a report.

## Ask a question or report a bug

Use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/sintaxasn/Fluence.Wpf/issues). For a bug, include the Fluence.Wpf version or commit, target framework, Windows version, theme and backdrop, expected behavior, actual behavior, and a minimal reproduction. A screenshot helps with a visual issue. For a PowerShell issue, include the host edition and version, whether it is STA or MTA, and the command used.

For a feature request, describe the user task and the control or behavior you expect. For a vulnerability, follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) and avoid posting exploit details in a public issue.
